title: salvia phlomoides subsp. africana
intro: Salvia phlomoides subsp. africana, commonly known as African sage, is a plant species within the mint family (Lamiaceae) native to the southwestern region of South Africa. African sage is valued for its various health benefits, including its potential to reduce inflammation, improve cognitive function, and alleviate symptoms of anxiety and depression. The therapeutic actions of African sage are attributed to its bioactive constituents, such as flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are believed to possess antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and neuroprotective properties. The bioactive constituents in African sage have been shown to exhibit antioxidant activity, inhibit the production of pro-inflammatory enzymes, and protect against oxidative stress and cellular damage.
